summary: School and library dependent on E-Rate funding for broadband access during pandemic; opposes any proposal to sunset or limit the program The comment opposes sunsetting E-Rate funding, emphasizing its importance for educational access and the need to preserve the program.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would result in significant funding loss for schools
claims.evidence_quote: If E-Rate funding was reduced or eliminated, my school district, Garden Grove Unified, would lose $15.2 Million in funding. In order to make this up, all other areas of the school district would be affected.

claims.requested_action: Reject proposals to sunset E-Rate funding
claims.argument: Taking the Internet funding away keeps students further from educational goals
claims.evidence_quote: Taking the Internet funding away only keeps them further from the goal of educated citizens of the United States.
